name: Ivern
title: the Green Father

Q.name: Rootcaller
Q.description: Ivern conjures a vine dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.7×AP magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range. Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy. Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.
Q.summary: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.

W.name: Brushmaker
W.description: Passive: While in brush and for 3 seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional 20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + 0.2×AP magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for 1.5 seconds and deal 10/15/20/25/30 + 0.1×AP magic damage. Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for 8 seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to 45 seconds.
W.summary: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.

E.name: Triggerseed
E.description: Ivern grants 75/115/155/195/235 + 0.5×AP Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After 2 seconds, it bursts, dealing 70/90/110/130/150 + 0.8×AP magic damage and Slowing enemies by 40/45/50/55.0/60% for 2 seconds. If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for 75/115/155/195/235 + 0.5×AP for 2 seconds.
E.summary: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.

R.name: Daisy!
R.description: Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for 45 seconds. Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing 90/140/190 + 0.5×AP magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for 1 second. This effect can only occur once every 3 seconds. Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move.
R.summary: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.

Passive.name: Friend of the Forest
Passive.description: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.
Passive.summary: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Enchanter jungler who frees camps without attacking and supports allies with shields and roots. His Q root lets allies dash in and Daisy adds damage and a knock-up.
strengths: Q root and dash for allies
profile.curveNote: Doesn't trade alone; ganks with Q root.
